item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.
